extracted.name: Mama’s White Sausage Gravy
extracted.description: This sausage gravy is amazing over homemade buttermilk biscuits (or even canned biscuits!). As a southern girl, this is definitely a wonderful comfort food.
instruction_lines: In a large skillet over medium high heat, cook sausage until brown and crumbly
Add butter and stir until melted
Turn down the skillet and Sprinkle the flour over the sausage and stir until flour becomes golden brown
And in the milk and stir. Allow the gravy to thicken, stirring occasionally.
Serve while hot. The gravy will thicken as it cools.
